title: GENERATION
logline: A backyard birthday tape repeats six times. Each copy loses people and image quality, until the empty yard returns clean.
overall: Published on YouTube Shorts, confirmed by the director. The final 4K and original sources are retained in a verified local archive.
next: No creative decisions remain. Future revisions start from a restored copy of the archive.

segments.title: V1: A crowded backyard birthday plays normally.
The birthday child is at the cake; W remains near the table.
V2: The smaller party continues its ordinary activity.
The birthday child is absent; nobody surveys the yard.
V3: W pauses, leans up briefly and returns to her seat.
A smaller crowd remains; this is the first visible hesitation.
V4: The scattered group grows still and looks around.
W rises and steps beside the table. The planned left exit is omitted.

scenes.title: W alone
scenes.summary: One woman; dub generation 5; chair action remains a draft limitation

segments.title: V5: W rises quickly; the chair slides upright rather than falling.
She exits right, returns and calls outward through heavy playback noise.
V6: Nobody remains; the yard returns clean.
Water, balloons and smoke move; the tape ends in snow and blue.

decisions.title: Literal repeat matching versus a convincing six-pass film
decisions.detail: The director chose: “Convincing six-pass film; small variations allowed.” Poses, small set details and guest counts may vary while the crowd diminishes and the ending returns clean.

log.text: Received generation-spine-v1, preserved the original, recorded Claude Fable 5.1 as writer, and began the authorized native draft.
Corrected the initial headcount and crop, removed the pool markings, and locked the 24-person base plate. The complete subtraction series is in progress.
The director allowed small continuity variations. Continue toward a convincing six-pass film, preserving the crowd reduction, W’s escalation and clean empty-yard ending.
Selected the six plate states. The third state has a smaller crowd than the original numerical target; the approved continuity tolerance applies.
Rejected duplicated people and unwanted entrants in early motion. Selected the final restrained fourth pass and the second solo take.
Built the exact 43-second cut, calibrated fine playback noise, stabilized camera drift and completed the per-copy mono mix.
Delivered native draft v1 for review. Every decoded frame passed the black-margin and PLAY timing checks; writer credit is retained in the canonical description.
Director: “Nailed it in one shot. Fabulous, fabulous. 4k upscale please.” Native v1 approved; local 4K finishing authorized.
Delivered the 4K master. Full-frame checks passed, all color tags are BT.709, and audio packet hashes and timing match native v1.
Director supplied the published YouTube Shorts URL: https://youtube.com/shorts/w7GsYaHtP6I. Recording this as user-confirmed publication of the delivered 4K master.

Verified the archive and final 4K hash, retained all original takes and stems, and removed 83 reviewed derivatives. All 22 library clips have complete required analysis and verified project-scoped private backups.
